g.title: PI
g.text: Physical pin numbers (odd = inner row from the SD-card end). i2c3 on BCM 4/5 needs dtoverlay=i2c3 (setup_pi.sh does it) and has NO on-board pull-ups: the MLX breakout's own 10 kΩ do the job. w1-gpio must stay off.

g.title: W_MLX
g.text: to the turret: leave a service loop for tilt

g.title: MLX
g.text: On i2c3 (BCM 4/5) ALONE. The breakout's own 10 kΩ pull-ups set the bus speed: 400 kHz (8 fps) — station.py uses 4 fps. Rides beside the webcam on the tilt bracket.

g.title: TOF_F
g.text: VL53L1X ToF FRONT (0x29 → re-addressed 0x30 by XSHUT)
Both ToFs share I2C-1. At boot the Pi holds FRONT XSHUT low, gives REAR 0x29… then raises FRONT and moves it to 0x30.

g.title: TOF_R
g.text: XSHUT on BCM 27 so the Pi can reset it independently.

g.title: MIC
g.text: L/R tied to GND = left channel. On the post front face, 120 mm up (assembly.py).
